reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Separate optical, reporter and target kinetics with substrate titration and proposed independent product validation.

checks.quote: The existing single-substrate, 30-minute coupled endpoint cannot be interpreted as target inhibition. Run a pre-specified four-module study on the purified enzymes: enzyme-free optical/fluorophore interference, reporter-enzyme-only activity, an orthogonal non-fluorescence readout of target product, and—only if a target effect remains—substrate-varied initial-rate tests of competitive versus other inhibition modes. Attribute the signal loss only after each upstream contribution is measured and subtracted or excluded.
checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior target/reporter Methods, supplements or a validated protocol before execution and check transfer of detailed conditions.
Activity/solubility/lot checks do not verify enzyme/compound identities, purity or authenticated stock concentrations.
Explicitly assumes the original buffer is known, but gives no source lookup or concrete buffer/cofactor/pH/temperature/amount calibration procedure if that unavailable prerequisite fails.

checks.quote: replaced by the pilot if instrument noise is larger
checks.reason: Equivalence margin is widened to instrument noise/achievable CI width rather than fixed to the largest scientifically negligible effect. More replication or an inconclusive decision is needed if the meaningful margin cannot be resolved.

checks.quote: Fix solubility or reagents and repeat
checks.reason: Describes repairs and new days after an initial pilot, but does not require refreezing a revised failed protocol and fresh independent confirmation after subsequent changes.
Independent direct chromatography is required, but matrix-specific recovery, quench efficiency and compound/product interference validation are not operationally specified.
Locked code and raw observations lack a linked raw-file/unit/provenance manifest and exact executable software/settings versions.
Prospective active, omission, optical/product bypass and qualified inactivation controls with stated interpretive roles.
